{{Quote|Welcome to Koda Spaceport. Welcome-zzzzz! to Koda Spzzzzzz! port&hellip;|A broken hospitality droid|<ref name="Brain Spiders">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Brain Spiders]]''</ref>}}
'''Koda Space Station''', sometimes referred to simply as '''Koda''', was a tiny spaceport in a backwater corner of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Brain Spiders" /> as the end of the [[Koda Spur/Legends|Koda Spur]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>.

==History==
The surrounding region of space was mostly populated by [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with poor farming communities, resulting in many farmhands visiting the station for excitement. The station was also visited by smugglers, and this mix meant that the station was often busy despite its insignificance.<ref name="Brain Spiders" />

[[0 ABY/Legends|Nine months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the fugitives [[Mammon Hoole]], and [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]] visited the station, using it as a temporary hideout. At this time, the station was poorly maintained, with trash lining many of the station's hallways. While there, the fugitives visited [[The End of the World/Legends|The End of the World]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], where Tash Arranda had a run-in with the serial killer [[Karkas]].<ref name="Brain Spiders" />

[[Passenger liner/Legends|Spaceliners]] occasionally traveled from Koda to the trading hub [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]], located at the nexus of three trade routes in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]].<ref name="Zygerrian" />

[[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] raiders attacked Koda Station during the initial stages of their invasion in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
